Penis disorders include: Erectile dysfunction - inability to get or keep an erection Priapism - a painful erection that does not go away Peyronie's disease - bending of the penis during an erection due to a hard lump called a plaque Balanitis - inflammation of the skin covering the head of the penis, most often in men and boys who have not been circumcised Penile cancer - a rare form of cancer, highly curable when caught early Start Here Penis Health: Identify and Prevent Problems (Mayo Foundation for Medical Education and Research) Also in Spanish Diagnosis and Tests Genital Problems in Men (American Academy of Family Physicians) Also in Spanish Stages of Penile Cancer (National Cancer Institute) Also in Spanish Tests for Penile Cancer (American Cancer Society) Prevention and Risk Factors Can Penile Cancer Be Prevented?
